adminless_accounts.go validates the primary attoparsec-iso8601-1.1.1.0
Data.Attoparsec.Time utcTime grammar used by the User expires_at schema.
This is validation-only: signed/extended Gregorian years, optional seconds,
leap seconds, fraction syntax and bounded offsets need no narrower Go time.Time
conversion. Original BSD3 notice must be included in source and future binary/
container distributions. Package copyright: Bryan O'Sullivan2011-2016 and
MailRank, Inc.2011. Readonly ELF strings in the pinned integration image identify the worker
package as1.1.1.0. This is package identity/source comparison; it does not execute
a native decoder or prove the full service.
https://hackage-content.haskell.org/package/attoparsec-iso8601-1.1.1.0/attoparsec-iso8601-1.1.1.0.tar.gz
